items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: It was a Sonny & Cher world out there, that television. It was people with no ability at all and no talent at all.

ctx.x: Well how did you like working a steady thing, a T.V. show every day?

Oh, I hated it. Just hated it. And then I went out to the coast and he tripled the money. The money was lousy in New York believe it or not. And we went out to the coast, and he more than tripled it. So we made good money out there. But it was even worse. It was awful. It’s a Sonny & Cher world out there, that television. It was people with no ability at all and no talent at all. Did you happen to watch the thing the other day, Quincy Jones trying to teach Bruce Springsteen and the poet/singer, what the hell’s…
